loss_taxonomy.methodology: Classified from closedDeck's real score/archetype/entryPremium/peakPremium/exitPnlPct/closedReason. BAD-ENTRY = marginal score (<35) and/or near-zero MFE before stopping. BAD-EXIT = real double-digit MFE (>=14%) fully round-tripped to a steep stop under zero intermediate protection below +100%. CLEAN STOP-OUT = moderate/high score, some real MFE, genuine reversal, exit policy correctly had nothing to fire yet. VARIANCE = high score, thin MFE, violent 1-session reversal.
